title: UI风格#153 - Retro Diner 50s (复古餐厅50年代)
description: 创建第153种UI风格：复古餐厅50年代风格 - 50年代美国餐厅、Checkerboard、Chrome。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planEW.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When color palette Then features cherry red, mint green, cream white, chrome silver
Given Retro Diner 50s style When typography Then uses retro fonts: Pacifico, Lobster, or Rockabilly
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Pacifico (headers 2.5rem), Lobster (body 0.95rem) - authentic 50s diner typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When layout Then checkerboard floor, neon signs, chrome counter, jukebox
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: checkerboard background pattern, chrome-bordered cards, retro diner aesthetic with 50s styling

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s style When UI elements Then neon glow, chrome reflections, checkerboard, milkshake
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: chrome silver borders, hot pink accents, heart icons, dashed borders, retro decorative elements

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s UI When functional Then includes diner chat, waitress agents, order stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: The Counter chat, 4 waitress agents (Rosie, Betty, Flo, Dolores) with Cherry/Fresh/Shakes/Cream/Coffee/Hot/Classic/Served stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner 50s UI When copy Then uses diner language: 'Order', 'Pie', 'Milkshake', 'Classic'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'ORDER. PIE. CLASSIC.', tagline '~ Welcome to the 50s Diner ~', button 'ORDER', greeting 'Hey there, honey! Welcome to Rosie's Diner...', status 'HERE'/'AWAY', nav 'Order'/'Served'/'Pie'/'Classic'
